runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 21:09 sweep across 14 actually searched source families. A new strong promotion-ready candidate was verified on the canonical employer page: AGEL Lab Administratívno technická podpora pre laboratórium, Údernícka 9 Petržalka, full-time, 1,350 EUR/month, start 1.10.2026 or by agreement, broad education eligibility and no foreign-language requirement shown. A Profesia mirror for the same role was found but the direct AGEL career page is canonical and preferred. LIVE promotion was not written because the available GitHub connector exposes jobs-data.json only as a truncated large response while updates require a complete replacement; fail-closed policy therefore prevented a blind write. Existing Telekom customer support, Telekom Magenta Experience and AlzaBox roles were reverified from direct company pages. LinkedIn surfaced Wolt part-time student support and KLARSTEIN Italian-market support; both were rejected on eligibility/language burden. StartupJobs surfaced Elasticr L2 support and Tipli Product Manager, both above target skill/seniority. Pretlak Stretchfit remains mid/senior creative. Public Facebook search again produced 0 verified direct hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Stable source-job-ID deduplication
developmentChanges.reason: Extract stable source job identifiers before fuzzy company+title identity so alternate/localized URLs cannot create duplicate LIVE cards.

developmentChanges.title: Dynamic recent-delta fallback
developmentChanges.reason: If a recent-delta manifest is stale or unavailable, derive a bounded fallback rather than silently hiding newly verified records.

developmentChanges.title: Manifest staleness diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: Separate source-verification age, content age and manifest age so an apparently fresh timestamp cannot hide stale evidence.

developmentChanges.title: Safer normalized identity dedupe
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize common legal-form and title boilerplate before final identity comparison while keeping stable IDs intact.

developmentChanges.title: Structured vs detail language reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: Store both structured and detailed language evidence and rank from the stricter verified requirement.

developmentChanges.title: Temporary-role value-density score
developmentChanges.reason: Score seasonal roles by hourly pay, schedule compatibility, transferable skills and application effort.

developmentChanges.title: Source-family query coverage fingerprint
developmentChanges.reason: Persist actual query themes per source family so repeated runs can detect blind spots.

developmentChanges.title: Candidate evidence-expiry queue
developmentChanges.reason: Prioritize near-expiry high-fit candidates for recheck before evidence becomes stale.

developmentChanges.title: Non-English market hard-gate extractor
developmentChanges.reason: Detect roles whose customer market implies a mandatory foreign language before expensive verification.

developmentChanges.title: Closed-variant sibling suppression
developmentChanges.reason: Cluster role-family siblings so closed variants do not inflate candidate or source-success counts.

developmentChanges.title: Outbound sales burden score
developmentChanges.reason: Separate cold-calling and quota-heavy roles from support/admin work in ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Onboarding location hard-gate
developmentChanges.reason: Track mandatory onboarding location separately from advertised remote mode.

developmentChanges.title: Mandatory certification hard-gate
developmentChanges.reason: Extract legally or operationally mandatory certificates before ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Posting-age vs index-age reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: Store original published age separately from search-engine crawl age.

developmentChanges.title: Language-band confidence score
developmentChanges.reason: Distinguish ambiguous B1-B2 ranges from explicit B2/C1 requirements and store confidence/evidence.

developmentChanges.title: Remote commute-event frequency gate
developmentChanges.reason: For remote/hybrid roles outside BA, extract frequency of mandatory office/client meetings before ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance client trust gate
developmentChanges.reason: Score client age, spend/hire history, scope specificity and compensation clarity before a freelance listing can enter LIVE.

developmentChanges.title: Application competition decay score
developmentChanges.reason: Use proposal count, client last-viewed time and listing age to deprioritize freelance jobs where response probability has decayed.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance hire-state gate
developmentChanges.reason: Treat existing hires/interviews as a separate conversion-risk signal so excellent-fit gigs are not promoted after the client has likely filled the need.

developmentChanges.title: Preferred-language fallback evidence
developmentChanges.reason: Separate preferred from mandatory language requirements and record whether AI/translation fallback is explicitly accepted.

developmentChanges.title: Requirement contradiction quarantine
developmentChanges.reason: When structured fields and prose disagree on hard requirements, quarantine the candidate until canonical evidence resolves the conflict.

developmentChanges.title: Mirror freshness divergence check
developmentChanges.reason: Compare canonical posting date with mirror/index freshness labels so resurfaced old vacancies are not treated as newly published.

developmentChanges.title: Rejected-candidate cooldown cache
developmentChanges.reason: Persist hard-reject fingerprints with a short TTL so hourly runs do not repeatedly spend verification time on the same unchanged language/skill/location mismatch; bypass the cooldown only when canonical evidence materially changes.

developmentChanges.title: Same-role requirement drift detector
developmentChanges.reason: When the same employer/title reappears, compare language, location, schedule, pay and skill requirements against the prior snapshot and re-open verification only on material drift; this catches improved reposts without duplicating unchanged roles.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance budget-to-scope ratio gate
developmentChanges.reason: Estimate realistic effort from listing scope and reject projects whose fixed budget implies an unreasonably low effective hourly rate before spending application time.

developmentChanges.title: Zero-result source health check
developmentChanges.reason: When a source family returns zero results, distinguish a genuinely empty search from indexing/parser failure by storing query execution and public-access evidence before marking the source checked.

developmentChanges.title: Search snippet vs canonical status reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: When category/search pages show a recent date but the canonical detail is old or expired, rank from canonical status and record the discrepancy so resurfaced vacancies cannot look fresh.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance effective-hourly floor
developmentChanges.reason: Estimate an effective hourly floor for fixed-price gigs from scope, test work, revisions and communication overhead; automatically reject tiny fixed budgets even when the task is a strong skill match.

developmentChanges.title: Student eligibility hard-gate
developmentChanges.reason: Extract student-status requirements before scoring brigades and part-time support roles so attractive local listings such as Wolt do not consume verification effort when a student contract is mandatory.

developmentChanges.title: Portfolio proof readiness score
developmentChanges.reason: For WordPress/WooCommerce freelance work, score whether the application can immediately supply the requested live examples, screenshots or case studies; lower roles where missing proof makes conversion unlikely despite a strong skill match.

developmentChanges.title: Write-capability preflight gate
developmentChanges.reason: Before a discovery run that may promote candidates, verify that jobs-data and MASTER can be safely read in full and written transactionally; if not, preserve promotion-ready evidence without risking destructive replacement.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical required-fields checksum
developmentChanges.reason: Persist a compact checksum of canonical location, language, pay, schedule, start/expiry and required skills so hourly rechecks can detect material changes without reprocessing unchanged listings.
